About Us
At Topicus, we believe IT should serve society. From healthcare and education to finance, our solutions empower millions of people every day by turning complex challenges into user-friendly platforms. We don't just build software; we increase self-reliance and reduce vulnerability for citizens worldwide.
 
With a team of over 1,800+ "Topicans" across Southeast Asia (Vietnam & Thailand) and Europe (the Netherlands, Romania, Portugal, and Iceland), we are constantly expanding our horizons. Our ambition reaches far beyond Europe, driven by a shared mission to make a meaningful difference.
 
About the Role
We are seeking .NET Developers with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in .NET development. Successful candidates will join our international team and contribute to the development of our Akkuro Mortgage platform (). This role involves close collaboration with team members in both Vietnam and the Netherlands, providing a dynamic and culturally diverse work environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain .NET applications with a focus on technical excellence.
Collaborate effectively with international team members to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to ensure smooth project execution.
Create and maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation.
Support team members through coaching and leadership, ensuring a high-performing and motivated team.
Frameworks and Tools Used
.NET Framework, .NET 8
Entity Framework
Web API
Dependency Injection (Autofac)
NServiceBus
NHibernate
Azure Pipelines
Helm Charts
